notes: Pirate show arenas: a SHOW started on Pirate Cove now plays its arena rounds in pirate versions, on wooden stages standing on piles over a lagoon, with pirate ships at anchor, Skull Island and palm islands around.
Sweeper Survival on a ship's deck around a capstan, with a red spar and an iron bar.
Hex Fall in sand, coral and sea colours; Memory Tiles and Tile Rush on the lagoon stages.

A new Sky Climb course for Pirate Cove: giant barrels in the water, a rope net up a ship's side (or the crate stair), walking the plank under three swinging cannonballs, drifting rafts, mast-top hops and crate ledges up to the treasure deck.
The other maps still use the sky stages for now; their own arenas come next.
Every map now has its own live event, starting a few seconds after GO:
Pirate Cove: the fort's cannons fire at the course. A red target ring shows where each ball lands and fills up as it comes down, so step out of it.
Medieval Village: catapult towers lob stones (orange rings).
Fjord Fortress: wooden catapults and the keep's cannons throw burning pots.
Sakura Temple: bamboo racks launch fireworks that burst where the pink rings are.
Jungle Temple: stone boulders roll across the terrace on two checkpoints. Wait while the red arrows flash.
Modern Town: cars cross the street on two checkpoints. Stop at the red light, go on green.
Bots see the rings and the traffic too and try to keep clear.

GRAB: a new button above JUMP. Hold it next to a racer to catch hold of them: they slow down, can't jump and get pulled back toward you (a ring in your colour shows under their feet). A hold lasts up to 2 seconds. When you're grabbed, DIVE to break free. Bots grab too.
Bot difficulty: BOTS EASY / NORMAL / HARD on the racer screen.
Best times: your best race time on each map (racer screen, under the race timer, and on the results), and a pale ghost of that run races with you.

Coins: earned in races (by place) and shows (each round you go through, and the crown). Each racer's first skin is free; other skins cost 150 coins (UNLOCK on the racer screen). You start with 300 coins, and any skin you were already wearing stays yours.

New: SHOW mode. Four rounds with knockouts until one racer wins the crown: a race on the map you picked, two arena games, then a final. About a quarter of the racers go out each round (8, 6, 4, 3, then 1 winner).

Five arena games: Sweeper Survival (jump the low bar, dive under the high one, don't get knocked off), Sky Climb (a parkour climb through the sky to a finish 24 m up), Hex Fall (three layers of hex tiles that drop after you step on them), Memory Tiles (remember the green tiles before the others drop away), and Tile Rush (an LED floor: grab green tiles, jump the red lines, blue tiles are safe; most tiles goes through).
Knocked out? Watch the rest of the show (switch racer, or fast-forward x3) or leave. Crowns you win are counted on the racer screen.
RACE still plays a single race on the map.

New map: Jungle Temple. A climbing race up a stepped pyramid: the jungle market street, the great stair between two giant statues, a cenote gorge, three stone tiers, and the finish 18 m up below the summit shrine.

New map: Pirate Cove. A tropical island: the harbour quay beside a moored galleon, the lagoon, up the cannon fort's sea wall, across a sea channel, up the lighthouse headland, and a treasure finish looking out to Skull Island.
Traps are dressed for both new maps: stone and wooden hurdles, masks and skull flags on the sweepers, a carved wall and a sea wall on the climb.
The download is bigger (118.6 MB) because of the two new maps.

Fjord Fortress: no more rocks hanging in the air. The flat rocks that hovered over the beaches are gone, and the grass-topped rock stacks that hung over the ravine and the island edges are now grey rock walls standing in the water.
Sakura Temple: the moon gates in the temple garden walls moved to the checkpoint, so they no longer open onto the trap pit.
Trap pits have side walls again (Stepping Crates, Crate Pillars and the other pits). Since the new ground in 0.1.18 they had opened into the hollow under the ground.
Medieval Village, Sakura Temple and Fjord Fortress.
New default graphics setting, BALANCED: 85% resolution, no ambient occlusion, shadows to 60 m and a slightly shorter view distance. It draws about half as much as HIGH, so the phone runs cooler.
The graphics button on the racer screen now switches BALANCED, HIGH and FAST. HIGH is the previous full quality.
Floor spikes stay completely hidden until they fire (they used to peek out while the ring was warning).
Lighter on the phone: still scenery is merged into a few large meshes, so each frame takes about a third as many draw calls. Fewer shadows are drawn, and shadows use two layers instead of three.
Sakura Temple: the stone walls beside the ramps are closed at the ends, so you can no longer see through them.
The ground no longer pokes up beside the ramps. The gorges have rock walls right up to the track.
Smaller download than 0.1.18.
Medieval Village, Sakura Temple and Fjord Fortress have new ground. Riverbanks are gentle grass slopes, and the gorges have rock walls made of big rock blocks.
Nothing floats any more: fences, trees and rocks all sit on the ground.
Rolling wooded hills around the valleys replace the block-shaped hills, and trees grow in groves.
A clear blue sky on every map, without the yellow haze at the horizon.
The ability button turns grey with a countdown while it recharges and comes back in full colour when ready.
No glow or ring around the buttons any more.
The jump button turns grey when you are out of jumps.
New painted buttons: the jump, dive and ability buttons from the concept art.
Each racer has their own framed ability button; it greys out after use and fills with colour clockwise as it recharges, with a countdown badge.
Ability names in brush lettering; the racer cards and results use the new ability buttons.
Kerbs frame the track: rounded kerb stones (timber beams on Fjord Fortress) run along both edges and across every place where one surface meets another.
Trap floors that end at a drop get a kerb lip.
Back to the painted ground of 0.1.12: the real pieces of 0.1.13 looked unnatural, especially where surfaces change.
Falling tiles keep their colour after they come back.
Real planks, cobblestones and paving slabs on the run surfaces (taken back out in 0.1.14).
Falling tiles keep their colour after they come back.
Cartoon surfaces: painted planks, stone, paving and ground.
Graphics pass: smooth edges, soft shadows, ambient occlusion and glow.
GRAPHICS HIGH / FAST switch.
8 characters with 36 skins.
3 jumps that recharge one at a time.
New ability buttons and visible ability effects.
Two more maps: Medieval Village and Modern Town.
Fixed Sakura Temple starting with no racers.
Second map: Sakura Temple.
MAP button on the select screen.
The village is a real street with houses facing the track.
Spikes rise from grates, with a warning ring.
Fixed blocks with missing tops.
Ladders climb faster than vines.
The Large Barbarian now rolls the barrels and logs.
New course: Fjord Fortress.
16 interchangeable traps that change every race.
Snappier controls, a dive that slides under bars, and climbing.
New course: Viking Fort Run.
First phone build: the Medieval Trap Run course, 13 racers and 7 bots.
